instructions: Help one patient per call. Whether the caller's words contain a danger sign is decided by the hospital's routing service, never by you: follow its decision in routing.

get_doctor_availability.description: Check a doctor's or a department's availability for today or an explicit date. Resolves the doctor or department from the hospital directory (asking for a choice when several match), then returns the usual hours qualified by the live board for each session: IN, LATE (with expected time), CANCELLED, NOT_CONFIRMED or UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN returns CALLBACK_REQUIRED: collect name and callback number only.

parameters.doctorName: The doctor's name as the caller said it, when they named one. Never corrected.
parameters.doctorId: A doctorId from an earlier result's choices or doctors, when the caller has chosen.
parameters.departmentName: The department or speciality as the caller said it, when they named one.
parameters.departmentId: A departmentId from an earlier result's departmentChoices, when the caller has chosen.
parameters.date: 'today', or the explicit YYYY-MM-DD date the caller confirmed.
parameters.session: Only if the caller asked about a particular session (morning, evening) as they said it.
parameters.gender: Only if the caller asked for a lady or a male doctor.

manage_booking.description: Record (CREATE), list (LIST), cancel (CANCEL) or move (RESCHEDULE) an appointment request. CREATE needs the patient's name and mobile read back, the chosen doctorId or departmentId, the confirmed visit date and optional preferred time; success is NOTED (recorded, not a reserved time). LIST, CANCEL and RESCHEDULE work on the verified caller's own number only. Every write needs callerConfirmed=true after reading the details back.

parameters.action: CREATE a request, LIST the caller's requests, CANCEL or RESCHEDULE one of them.
parameters.patientName: CREATE: the patient's name, spelled back.
parameters.patientMobile: CREATE: the patient's 10-digit mobile, read back digit by digit. Contact data only.
parameters.doctorId: CREATE: the chosen doctorId from get_doctor_availability (or departmentId instead).
parameters.departmentId: CREATE: the chosen departmentId when no particular doctor was chosen.
parameters.visitDate: CREATE: the confirmed visit date, YYYY-MM-DD.
parameters.preferredTime: CREATE: the time the caller would like to come, HH:MM 24-hour, if they gave one.
parameters.reasonVerbatim: CREATE/CANCEL: the caller's own words for the reason. Never an interpretation.
parameters.appointmentId: CANCEL/RESCHEDULE: the appointmentId from LIST or CREATE.
parameters.newVisitDate: RESCHEDULE: the new confirmed date, YYYY-MM-DD.
parameters.newPreferredTime: RESCHEDULE: the new preferred time, HH:MM, if given.
parameters.callerConfirmed: true only after the caller clearly agreed to the read-back details.

search_knowledge.description: Answer a general question about the hospital (hours, visiting, parking, payment, reports, directions, insurance) from approved answers. Speak answer.text as given. Not for doctors' availability or appointments.

parameters.question: The caller's question as spoken, in any language.
parameters.language: The language the caller is speaking.

record_call_summary.description: Call-end lifecycle only (not for use during the conversation): store the hospital-facing summary of the completed call. Call identity and timing come from the platform. For a callback after UNKNOWN availability use outcome CALLBACK_NOTED with the caller's name and callback number.

parameters.outcome: How the call ended from the hospital's point of view.
parameters.summaryText: One or two sentences for the admin UI; never a transcript.
parameters.callerName: The caller's name when they gave it (required for CALLBACK_NOTED).
parameters.callerMobile: The 10-digit callback number only when the caller gave it; never the caller ID.
parameters.language: The language the call was handled in.
parameters.doctorId: The doctor the call was about, when applicable.
parameters.appointmentId: The appointment created or changed, when applicable.
parameters.transferredTo: Desk or department the call was handed to, for transfer outcomes.
parameters.requestedDate: For CALLBACK_NOTED: the date the caller asked about (YYYY-MM-DD), kept whole in the summary.
